labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory: the CVE output concerns Pygments, a Rich dependency, not Rich's own code.

body:
This advisory is about Pygments, which Rich depends on, not about Rich's own code. The pip-audit output names `pygments 2.19.2` (CVE-2026-4539), so the fix belongs with the Pygments project. Rich has no separate security finding here, and this is not a Rich vulnerability report.

If you believe a Rich-specific vulnerability exists, please report it privately as described in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than in a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
